new_rows.row: owner report body; R12 ISA, FOIL30 alone, 30 days
new_rows.finding: The report rounds up incorrectly; the card and machine data already show the correct result.
new_rows.action: Use +47.34 kg in summaries. No route, mass model or closure change.

new_rows.row: cold humidity design input and capture free-volume convention
new_rows.finding: The full cold target differs from the upstream 052 input by 1.5380359e-7 Pa. All 2816 strict differences reconcile at the declared 054 target. The equivalent hardware density and inclusion of housing plus all five kg hardware are not specified fully in METHOD.
new_rows.action: Publish the precise cold target and Vcapture=V052-Mbed/600-(housing+5)/1000, and distinguish projected equivalent volume from a measured installation.
new_rows.numerical_status: reconciled; no displayed result, route or payload changes

new_rows.source_condition: Kevlar49 bone-dry yarn equilibrated at 24 C/55% RH; also typical as-shipped moisture
new_rows.finding: One percent is an engineering allowance, not the manufacturer's moisture datum. The 84-case 3.5% finite-release sensitivity changes no payloads and has no pressure failure through 30 days; maximum 776.2574324310921 Pa.
new_rows.action: Measure initial moisture, sorption/release kinetics and pressure rise on the installed aramid stack; preserve both sensitivities.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Service WVTR
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: No installed laminate rate at48.79C, cyclic cold/heat and service water pressure is measured. Twofold rate defeats the R10 seven-day SiOx/3A closure.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure WVTR of the final aged, strained and seamed stack across actual T/RH; target<=0.08551g/m2/day for7days or<=0.01614 for30days in the stated R10 mass account.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Flex, creases and defects
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: Flat coupon values do not include deployment folds, abrasion, crease pinholes or square-kilometre-equivalent defect statistics.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure leak and WVTR after representative forming, flex, handling, UV and abrasion; include seams and penetrations.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Carrier and coating weights
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: ALD paper omits PET gauge; R10 ML3 zero-payload carrier limit is28.07um. SiOx/Verreal coat2g/m2 and foil adhesive3g/m2 are allowances.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Weigh the complete final laminate including all carrier, coatings, primer, adhesive and opacity layers. Do not use the12um recipe as a sourced product.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: ALD evidence floor and aging
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: Claimed sub1e-5 performance is below the stated5e-5 instrument sensitivity; oxide durability and PET transfer are unqualified.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Confirm detection limit, reporting bounds, long-term oxide protection and flex performance on the final carrier.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Light and thermal protection
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: Added Al opacity and inherited white/attachment package are not verified OD4 or actual optical/thermal properties for new laminates.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure spectral transmission, aged absorptivity/emissivity and adhesion of the complete package.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Whole-hull leakage and dry gas
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: Inherited seam/node/port leaks and dry-species permeability are assumptions. Dry ingress limits nominal ultrabarrier intervals.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure full pressure-rise/species curves and actual leak rates; resolve all pressure-normalised permeability units.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Adsorbent equilibrium transfer
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: 6wt%working screen applies to the source3A isotherm,1wt%initial moisture and333K maximum bed temperature. Vendor/cation variation and contamination are unknown.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure actual batch isotherm and cyclic working capacity at10–33Pa with the relevant temperatures and co-adsorbates.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Adsorption transport and heat rejection
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: R10 seven-day SiOx system requires about277m3/h effective water conductance and16.54W peak heat rejection.5kg distribution/monitoring plus25%housing are unverified.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Demonstrate distributed access, dust retention, thermal coupling and bed temperature without unpriced fans or pumps; weigh functional hardware.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Conditioning and regeneration
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: Initial90%conditioning and1day release time constant are inherited proxies. Ground350C regeneration energy assumes cp1kJ/kg/K and2xloss factor.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure drydown, repeat-cycle residual moisture, vacuum pumping work, cooldown and handling. Regenerate outside the PBO enclosure.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Power and spare-mass fragility
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: R10 seven-day screen has1.12kgpayload.5W monitoring instead of0.5W makes it negative; additional transport hardware could erase it.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Build an actual electrical/installation bill and mission duty cycle, including sensors, batteries, mounts, thermal parts and contingency.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: PBO humidity-dose criterion
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: 5%of cold saturation is an inference from dry protected-yarn evidence, not a demonstrated long-term loaded-laminate safe boundary.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure loaded PBO/resin/interface strength retention under the full coupled moisture, temperature and light history.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Aramid installed strength
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: 3GPa is conditioned yarn;95%retention,100%film efficiency and inherited thermal factor are optimistic assumptions.60%efficiency loses most favourable-weather closure.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Measure balanced membrane strength, creep, thermal mismatch, seams and long-term humid-service retention.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: UHMWPE creep
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: SK99/DM20 exceed1%creep over30days at900MPa/30C; thin strength-sized films are more highly stressed and warmer.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Obtain stress/temperature/time creep and rupture data for actual laminate; do not apply a single900MPa rate to higher stresses.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: M5 and LCP evidence gaps
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: No qualified M5/PIPD humid-service membrane allowable found. Accessible LCP chart is relative, not absolute WVTR.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Obtain absolute gauge/rate/condition/areal-mass records for LCP and relevant loaded wet-strength data for M5 before numeric credit.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: 052 structural and weather assumptions
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: All favourable-member, nonlinear-shell, joint, film, water, mooring and weather limitations from052 remain open. Both-weather closes nowhere here.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Carry forward052NFI without dilution; confirm the entire actual structure and environmental loading.

owner_054_rows_retained.title: Local installation and free volume
owner_054_rows_retained.finding: Bed/housing volume is included but distribution stiffness, load introduction, detailed barrier solid volume and microlocal humidity are not resolved.
owner_054_rows_retained.proposed_fix: Integrate and test local mounts, thermal paths and humidity gradients; rerun structural/displacement accounting for final geometry.

rows.title: Full-member compression distribution
rows.finding: 3.9 GPa is typical catalog compression, not a fitted scale at a known reference size. The 1 GPa baseline is only a ranking target.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure the actual full-length/full-wall production tube population in compression, including finish, joints and proof history.

rows.title: Linear frame and local shell interaction
rows.finding: Constant-g/R scaling retains checked linear fields. The 0.2 eigen knockdown and local peak substitution do not qualify imperfections or nonlinear collapse.
rows.proposed_fix: Validate joints, geometric imperfections and coupled local/global behavior for the final resized sections.

rows.title: Rigid joints
rows.finding: Sleeve sizing does not demonstrate rotational stiffness, peel, torsion, fatigue or temperature-dependent bond behavior.
rows.proposed_fix: Demonstrate the assembled joint stiffness and multiaxial load envelope at the actual installation.

rows.title: PBO effective ply strength
rows.finding: The 10 m least root requires about 5.343 GPa effective ply strength; 60% of yarn strength does not close this radius even with the other endpoints.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure biaxial crossply strength, construction efficiency, seams, attachments and sustained load.

rows.title: Ten-year retention
rows.finding: Warehouse extrapolation and .995/year protection target are not measured installed life. OD4 and white mass do not establish a durable coating.
rows.proposed_fix: Qualify combined light, humidity, stress, temperature, abrasion, fatigue and repair histories.

rows.title: Humidity criterion and service
rows.finding: 5% of cold saturation is a design target; h=2 shortens the nominal first interval. Initial fill is assumed dry.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure the complete internal dewpoint distribution and establish an operating interval including uncertainty.

rows.title: Barrier leakage and conditioning
rows.finding: OD3 coupon gas/WVTR and old outgassing inventories are transferred to installed OD4; 90% removal is assumed demonstrated.
rows.proposed_fix: Measure whole-hull leak acceptance, installed WVTR and a compatible conditioning endpoint.

rows.title: Onboard pumping and energy
rows.finding: 15–148 pump units arise from constant nominal-speed and 1000 W planning assumptions; this is not optimized or qualified hardware.
rows.proposed_fix: Obtain installed wet-speed curves near 32.5 Pa and a complete power/heat/plumbing design; recalculate changed barrier and power architectures explicitly.

rows.title: Load introduction and wind
rows.finding: Uniform pressure envelope and a P2-sized pad mass do not establish P3 attachment strength or nonuniform wind loading.
rows.proposed_fix: Resolve full wind, gust, mooring, payload, cable and landing load paths on the discrete frame.

rows.title: Damage tolerance
rows.finding: 045 reports cascading member loss and running tears in predecessor configurations. No damage-tolerance repair is qualified or silently assigned zero cost here.
rows.proposed_fix: Demonstrate residual strength, tear arrest, impact resistance and realistic protection/inspection; carry all added mass.

rows.title: Size scaling and optimality
rows.finding: Only the two checked f5 gyration families are assessed. Larger manufactured tubes and thermal interactions are not validated.
rows.proposed_fix: Search further sections/topologies using independently checked force/eigen solutions and manufacturing limits before claiming a global radius minimum.

rows.title: Installed inventory
rows.finding: Systems100, node, installation and mooring lines are planning allowances. The 10 m full-endpoint margin is only about 31 kg.
rows.proposed_fix: Replace allowances with a component bill including sensors, fixtures, mounting, valves, access, repair and handling hardware.

rows.title: Gas and water location
rows.finding: Bores must be vented. Material water is counted once in material mass; exterior .1 kg/m² water is separate. More external water can erase the margin.
rows.proposed_fix: Verify bore venting, actual liquid retention/drainage and material moisture at launch.

rows.title: P2 comparability
rows.finding: P2 endpoints have different unqualified material, thermal, bond and life assumptions. 048 stopped at radius15.
rows.proposed_fix: Do not rank confidence from payload or axis count; any larger-radius 048 extension needs its own thermal and mechanical calculation.

rows.title: Reliability aggregation
rows.finding: Only an intact-member compression hazard envelope is reported. Independence, compression m=10, load sharing and reference volume are hypothetical.
rows.proposed_fix: Calibrate failure mechanisms and common causes before assembling a hull probability; do not substitute either number for installed reliability.
